scope: Library consumption in a software unit with an explicit instance namespace (qualify_library_units.py at 49fc206, build 49fc206 frozen at artifacts/lx2, 57/57 steps): LibraryUnitSeeder creates unit TiaMcp_LibUnit with namespace preset TiaMcp_LibUnit. The UDT 1.0.0 instantiated into the unit without a namespace keeps its type's empty namespace (the preset is not applied). library_instantiate with namespace in the PLC root is refused (TargetIncompatible) and a malformed namespace is refused (InvalidRequest), both without a native change. With namespace=TiaMcp_LibUnit the preview declares instanceNamespace for the FB (type namespace empty, unit preset TiaMcp_LibUnit); apply creates FB 1.0.0 in the unit under /namespaces/TiaMcp_LibUnit/ with its exact version link while the UDT stays outside a namespace. The FB in the PLC root and a second UDT copy are refused (LibraryConflict), a PLC-wide update is refused while unit uses have no OB-rooted reference (LibraryUpdateCleanupRisk) and copies no version. The instantiation's checkpoint restores the project with the UDT only into a fresh owned TIA; a fresh reopen of the saved project shows the namespaced FB and the UDT with one exact FB use.
limitations: One software unit without unit relations; unit uses are conservatively unreachable for updates.
The unit is created by scripts/native/LibraryUnitSeeder (a registered fixture tool), not by an MCP route.
The explicit namespace is exercised on one FB root whose UDT dependency is reused; created dependencies keep their type namespace, unexercised.

steps: refuse an explicit namespace in the PLC root
preview declares namespace TiaMcp_LibUnit for the FB
the created FB carries the namespace and its exact link
FB in namespace TiaMcp_LibUnit and UDT without, both in the unit
refuse the FB in the PLC root while the unit holds it

restored: the UDT only, no FB
